It can be used to illustrate the duration of memory consumption where a small spike in memory demand may have less of an impact than a smaller amount of memory used over a longer period of time.

This option should only be used with CICS TORs, the associated AORs should remain at the default "manage region using goals of transaction". */(V)

SMF30S1.description: For interval records, the largest percentage of CPU time used by any task in this address space, rounded to the nearest integer. SMF30S5.description: For interval records, the largest percentage of CPU time used by any task in this address space, rounded to the nearest integer. The percentage value is calculated as: TCB time * 100 / interval time. For step-end and job-end records, the value is the largest reported interval value.

SMF30S5.name: highest_task_cpu_prog_name
SMF30S5.description: Program name running in the task that used the largest percentage of CPU time in the address space. This field corresponds to SMF3 0_Highest_Task_CPU_Percent. A value of blanks indicates that no task reported any CPU time in the address space, or that the CPU time could not be obtained. A value of '????????' indicates that the program name could not be obtained for the task that reported the highest percentage of CPU time.

SMF30S6.name: highest_task_cpu_percent
SMF30S6.description: For interval records, the largest percentage of CPU time used by any task in this address space, rounded to the nearest integer. The percentage value is calculated as: TCB time * 100 / interval time. For step-end and job-end records, the value is the largest reported interval value.

SMF30S6.name: highest_task_cpu_prog_name
SMF30S6.description: Program name running in the task that used the largest percentage of CPU time in the address space. This field corresponds to SMF3 0_Highest_Task_CPU_Percent. A value of blanks indicates that no task reported any CPU time in the address space, or that the CPU time could not be obtained. A value of '????????' indicates that the program name could not be obtained for the task that reported the highest percentage of CPU time.

SMF70S1.description: Logical processor effective dispatch time, in microseconds. When associated with partition name *PHYSICAL*, this field contains the accumulated number of microseconds during which a physical CPU was busy but the time could not be attributed to a specific logical partition or to LPAR management of the physical processor. One example is time managing coupling facility traffic. This field is zero, if not supported by the hardware. LPAR management time is the time from SMF70PDT associated with partition name *PHYSICAL* less the contents of this field.

SMF70S1.name: dispatch_time_total
SMF70S1.description: Logical processor total dispatch time, in microseconds. When associated with partition name *PHYSICAL*, this field contains the accumulated number of microseconds during which a physical CPU was busy but the time could not be attributed to a specific logical partition. This time includes the time PR/SM was controlling the physical processor (LPAR management time) as well as any other time the processor was busy for any reason such as managing coupling facility traffic.

SMF70S1.name: gmu
SMF70S1.description: Group maximum licensing units. The maximum number of processor licensing units for the group of logical partitions identified by having the same group name, of which this partition is a member, and which may be consumed per unit of time, on average. Valid if bit 1 (SMF70GRP) of SMF70PFL is ON.

SMF70S1.name: lacb

SMF70S1.name: lacm
SMF70S1.description: Long-term average CPU service (millions of service units) consumed by transactions classified with reporting attribute MOBILE. If an address space or enclave is part of a tenant resource group, it will not contribute to SMF70LACM.

Where x is the value that defines the maximum number of topology nesting level.

SMF70S1.name: maxpu
SMF70S1.description: When non-zero, this field indicates how many processor cores are physically available in this particular machine. When the value is 0, it is not defined for this model.

SMF70S1.description: Model capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the model capacity as identified in field SMF70MDL.

SMF70S1.name: mdl
SMF70S1.description: EBCDIC CPC model identifier. See Bit 4 of SMF70STF (SMF70HWV)

SMF70S1.name: mdl_var
SMF70S1.description: EBCDIC model variable capacity identifier. The identifier is left justified with trailing blanks if necessary. This field is zero, if not supported by the hardware.

SMF70S1.name: mpc
SMF70S1.description: When non-zero, EBCDIC model permanent capacity identifier of the configuration. The identifier is left justified with trailing blanks if necessary.

SMF70S1.name: mpr
SMF70S1.description: Model permanent capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the model capacity as identified in field SMF70MPC.

SMF70S1.name: msu
SMF70S1.description: Defined capacity limit (in millions of service units) that a logical partition may consume per unit time on average (extended mode only)

SMF70S1.name: mtc
SMF70S1.description: When non-zero, EBCDIC model temporary capacity identifier of the configuration. The identifier is left justified with trailing blanks if necessary.

SMF70S1.name: mtid
SMF70S1.description: Maximum Thread Identification. A non-zero value indicates that PROCVIEW CORE is effective for this partition and the hardware supports multithreading.

SMF70S1.name: mtit
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading Idle Time in microseconds accumulated for all threads of a dispatched core. This field is only valid if SMF70MTID is not zero for this partition.

SMF70S1.name: mtr
SMF70S1.description: Model temporary capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the model capacity as identified in field SMF70MTC.

SMF70S1.description: Multithreading capacity numerator for general purpose processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading capacity factor for all general purpose processors that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval.

SMF70S1.name: multithreading_cap_cp_max
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for general purpose processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all general purpose processors that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval.

SMF70S1.name: multithreading_cap_zaap
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading capacity numerator for zAAP processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get get the multithreading capacity factor for all zAAPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zAAP is currently installed

SMF70S1.name: multithreading_cap_zaap_max
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zAAP processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zAAPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zAAP is currently installed

SMF70S1.name: multithreading_cap_ziip
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading capacity numerator for zIIP processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get get the multithreading capacity factor for all zIIPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zIIP is currently installed

SMF70S1.name: multithreading_cap_ziip_max
SMF70S1.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zIIP processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zIIPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zIIP is currently installed

SMF70S1.name: mvcr
SMF70S1.description: Model variable capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the model capacity as identified in field SMF70MDL_VAR.

SMF70S1.name: mvs

SMF70S1.name: mvs_busy_percentage
SMF70S1.description: Total MVS busy percentage, per CPU type(V)

SMF70S1.name: ncr
SMF70S1.description: Nominal model-capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the nominal model capacity as identified in field SMF70MDL. When field SMF70CAI contains a value of 100, this value equals the value in field SMF70MCR.

SMF70S1.name: npr
SMF70S1.description: Nominal permanent model-capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the nominal permanent model capacity as identified in field SMF70MPC. When field SMF70CAI contains a value of 100, this value equals the value in field SMF70MPR.

SMF70S1.name: nrm
SMF70S1.description: Normalization factor for zIIP Multiply zIIP time by this value and divide by 256 to get the equivalent time on a CP

SMF70S1.name: nsa

SMF70S1.name: nsi
SMF70S1.description: Number of Diagnose samples within the specified minimum (+10%)

SMF70S1.name: ntr
SMF70S1.description: Nominal temporary model-capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the nominal temporary model capacity as identified in field SMF70MTC. When field SMF70CAI contains a value of 100, this value equals the value in field SMF70MTR.

SMF70S1.name: nvcr
SMF70S1.description: Nominal model variable capacity rating. When non-zero, this value is associated with the nominal model capacity as identified in field SMF70MDL_VAR. When field SMF70CAI contains a value of 100, this value equals the value in field SMF70MVCR.

SMF70S1.name: physical_proc_chng

SMF70S1.name: pml
SMF70S1.description: Swapped-in starvation threshold. When an address space or enclave not received CPU service within this time interval although it has ready-to-tun work, it is considered being blocked (OPT parameter BLWLINTHD)

SMF70S1.name: pmp

SMF70S1.name: pmt

SMF70S1.name: pmu
SMF70S1.description: Number of blocked dispatchable units being promoted during the interval

SMF70S1.name: pmw
SMF70S1.description: Accumulated number of address spaces and enclaves being blocked during the interval. To get the average number of waiters for promote, divide SMF70PMW by SMF70SAM.

SMF70S1.name: poc
SMF70S1.description: Polarization indication changed during the interval(V)

SMF70S1.name: poi

SMF70S1.name: pow
SMF70S1.description: Weight for the logical CPU when HiperDispatch mode is active. See bit 2 (SMF70PWF) of SMF70PFL. Multiplied by a factor of 4096 for more granularity. The value may be the same or different for all shared CPUs of type SMF70CIX. This is an accumulated value. Divide by the number of Diagnose samples SMF70DSA to get the average weight value for the interval.

SMF70S1.description: Multithreading core productivity numerator. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading core productivity. A zero value is reported if the core was not configured ONLINE for the complete interval. If SMF70_CPU_NUM is greater than 1, the core productivity represents the percentage of how much work the core resources accomplished while dispatched to physical hardware over the maximum amount of work the core resources could have accomplished while dispatched to physical hardware.

SMF72S3.name: r723cetsx
SMF72S3.description: Sum of transaction elapsed times squared. Same as R723CETS, but in microseconds.

SMF72S3.name: r723cfea
SMF72S3.description: Foreign enclave total transaction active time (in 1024 microsecond units).

SMF72S3.description: Total hiperspace page-in count (floating point 64-bit long format)

SMF72S3.description: Total DASD I/O disconnect time in 128 microsecond units. Does not include IOS queue time.

SMF72S3.description: Total DASD IOS queue time in 128 microsecond units (long floating point)

SMF72S3.name: r723ciwt
SMF72S3.description: Total DASD I/O wait time (queue time + pending time in 128 microsecond units)

SMF72S3.name: r723cpir

SMF72S3.description: Total shared page residency time (1024 microseconds) (long floating point)

SMF72S3.description: x'08' System specified goal(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723cswc
SMF72S3.description: Total swap count

SMF72S3.name: r723ctdq
SMF72S3.description: Total delay samples always including batch queue delay. For service classes that contain batch jobs that were not run in WLM managed initiators the batch queue delay samples are derived from the measured batch queue delay time. For service classes that contain jobs that ran in WLM managed initiators this value is the same as RCEATOTD. RCAETOTDQ can be used as a migration aid to determine what a batch service class period's velocity will be if its jobs are run in WLM managed initators

SMF72S3.name: r723ctetx
SMF72S3.description: Total transaction elapsed time. Same as R723CTET, but in microseconds.

SMF72S3.name: r723ctrr
SMF72S3.description: Total in storage residency time (1024 microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

SMF72S3.name: r723ctsa
SMF72S3.description: Total execution samples. It is the sum of RCAETOTU, RCAETOTD, RCAEUNKN and RCAEIDLE. Also always includes I/O using/delay samples whether or not I/O samples are included in RCAETOTU or RCAETOTD, respectively. (Long floating point)

SMF72S3.name: r723cvel
SMF72S3.description: x'20' Execution velocity goal goal(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723cwmn
SMF72S3.description: Number of entries in the work/resource manager states area associated with this service class period (R723CWMX points to the first entry)

SMF72S3.name: r723cwmx
SMF72S3.description: Index into the work/resource manager states area

SMF72S3.name: r723cxea
SMF72S3.description: Exported enclave total transaction active time (in 1024 microsecond units).

SMF72S3.name: r723cxetx
SMF72S3.description: Total transaction execution time. Same as R723CXET, but in microseconds.

SMF72S3.name: r723dnde
SMF72S3.description: Resource delay description

SMF72S3.name: r723dnnu
SMF72S3.description: Number of the resource delay type. Values 1-15 are related to R723RW01-R723RW15

SMF72S3.name: r723dnst
SMF72S3.description: Subsystem type as used in the classification rules specified in the WLM administrative application

SMF72S3.name: r723ectc
SMF72S3.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised by enqueue management because the work held a resource that other work needed (in 1024 microsecond units)

SMF72S3.name: r723enctrxcalls
SMF72S3.description: Number of times transaction data has been reported by subsystem work managers when deleting an enclave.

SMF72S3.name: r723enctrxet
SMF72S3.description: Total execution time in microseconds for number of subsystem transactions in R723ENCTRXNUM. (format: float)

SMF72S3.name: r723enctrxets
SMF72S3.description: Sum of squared execution times in microseconds for number of subsystem transactions in R723ENCTRXNUM. (format: float)

SMF72S3.name: r723enctrxnum
SMF72S3.description: Number of single subsystem transactions processed within enclaves.

SMF72S3.name: r723gglt
SMF72S3.description: Resource group flags

SMF72S3.name: r723ggmn
SMF72S3.description: If R723GMNS is ON, minimum capacity of the resource group. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC and R723GGMS are OFF, this value is in unweighted CPU service units per second. In addition, the scope of the resource group is sysplex-wide. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC or R723GGMS is ON, see description of R723GGLT

SMF72S3.name: r723ggms
SMF72S3.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in MSU/h rather than in service units(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723ggmx
SMF72S3.description: If R723GMXS is ON, maximum capacity of the resource group. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC and R723GGMS are OFF, this value is in unweighted CPU service units per second. In addition, the scope of the resource group is sysplex-wide. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC or R723GGMS is ON, see description of R723GGLT

SMF72S3.name: r723ggpc
SMF72S3.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in percentage of a single processor capacity rather than in service units. In addition, the scope of the resource group is system-wide rather than sysplex-wide(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723ggpv
SMF72S3.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in percentage of the LPAR share rather than in service units. In addition, the scope of the resource group is system-wide rather than sysplex-wide(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723ggtf
SMF72S3.description: Tenant resource group flags

SMF72S3.name: r723ggti
SMF72S3.description: Tenant identifier. Only valid if R723GTRG is ON.

SMF72S3.name: r723gisp
SMF72S3.description: Specialty processor consumption is included into the WLM capping algorithms, i.e. R723GGMN and R723GGMX limit the combined general purpose and specialty processor consumption(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723ifcu
SMF72S3.description: zAAP on CP using samples. These are included in R723CCUS

SMF72S3.name: r723lpdp
SMF72S3.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised to shorten the lock hold time of a local suspend lock (in 1024 microsecond units).

SMF72S3.name: r723mapo
SMF72S3.description: At least one zAAP online in sysplex (or local system when not joined to a sysplex)(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723mbai
SMF72S3.description: WLM batch initiator management is AI infused(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723mcf
SMF72S3.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for general purpose processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multi threading maximum capacity factor for all general purpose processors that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval.

SMF72S3.name: r723mcfi
SMF72S3.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zAAP. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zAAPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zAAP is currently installed.

SMF72S3.name: r723mcfs
SMF72S3.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zIIP. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zIIPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zIIP is currently installed.

SMF72S3.name: r723mdis
SMF72S3.description: Service class and tenant report class periods that are assoc iated with a resource group and have assigned a discretionary goal are excluded from workload management(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723merf
SMF72S3.description: ERV resource factor coefficient (from RMPTOPE)

SMF72S3.name: r723mfl2
SMF72S3.description: Additional flags

SMF72S3.name: r723mflg
SMF72S3.description: Flags

SMF72S3.name: r723midu
SMF72S3.description: Userid that installed the service definition

SMF72S3.name: r723mopt
SMF72S3.description: OPT member suffix (RCAAOPT)

SMF72S3.name: r723mscf
SMF72S3.description: Service class flags

SMF72S3.name: r723msucp
SMF72S3.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, executed on general purpose processors.

SMF72S3.name: r723msuocp
SMF72S3.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

SMF72S3.name: r723msusp
SMF72S3.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, executed on specialty processors.

SMF72S3.name: r723mtdi
SMF72S3.description: Local time/date the service definition was installed

SMF72S3.name: r723mtpa
SMF72S3.description: Local time/date of policy activation

SMF72S3.name: r723mtvl
SMF72S3.description: Current sample interval (in milliseconds). This is the frequency with which WLM samples delays reported in the RCAA

SMF72S3.name: r723nadj
SMF72S3.description: Nominal adjustment factor for CPU rate

SMF72S3.name: r723plsc
SMF72S3.description: Service class that last contributed to this report class period during this interval. Blank if this is a service class period

SMF72S3.name: r723ract
SMF72S3.description: Total number of active state samples. Active indicates that there is a program executing on behalf of the work request, from the perspective of the work manager. This does not mean that the program is active from the base control program's perspective

SMF72S3.name: r723rapp
SMF72S3.description: Total number of active application state samples

SMF72S3.name: r723rbpm
SMF72S3.description: Number of state samples representing buffer pool misses that resulted in I/O

SMF72S3.name: r723rcod
SMF72S3.description: Contention delay samples count or work waiting for resources as reported to WLM by a resource manager

SMF72S3.name: r723rcou
SMF72S3.description: Contention using samples count of work holding resources as reported to WLM by a resource manager

SMF72S3.name: r723rdbe
SMF72S3.description: x'80' Represents states sampled in the begin-to-end phase of a transaction(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723rdnn
SMF72S3.description: Number of entries in the resource delay names table

SMF72S3.name: r723rdnx
SMF72S3.description: Index into the resource delay names table

SMF72S3.name: r723ress
SMF72S3.description: Total number of transaction states sampled in the work phase specified by R723RFLG

SMF72S3.name: r723rexe
SMF72S3.description: x'40' Represents states sampled in the execution phase of a transaction(V)

SMF72S3.name: r723rflg
SMF72S3.description: Work/Resource manager flags

SMF72S3.name: r723ridl
SMF72S3.description: Total number of idle state samples. Idle indicates that no work reques is available to the work manager that is allowed to run.

SMF72S3.name: r723rrdy
SMF72S3.description: Total number of ready state samples. Ready indicates that there is a program ready to execute on behalf of the work request described by the monitoring environment, but the work manager has given priority to another work request

SMF72S3.name: r723rssl
SMF72S3.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations on this MVS image. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component within the same MVS image

SMF72S3.name: r723rssn
SMF72S3.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations somewhere within the network. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component within the network

SMF72S3.name: r723rsss
SMF72S3.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations on another MVS image in the sysplex. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component on another MVS image within the sysplex

SMF72S3.name: r723rtdc
SMF72S3.description: Number of midpoint changes that occurred during interval

SMF72S3.name: r723rtdm
SMF72S3.description: Midpoint of all response times that were collected in the response time distribution buckets in milliseconds. For response time goals, the mid point is always the response time goal. For execution velocity goals, it is the average of all response times that were collected in the response time distribution buckets. The field equals zero for discretionary goals.

SMF72S3.name: r723rtdt
SMF72S3.description: Timestamp showing the last time when a midpoint change occurred. The midpoint is kept in R723RTDM.

SMF72S3.name: r723rtyp
SMF72S3.description: Subsystem type, as used in the classification rules specified in the WLM administrative application. The subsystem's documentation should explain the meaning that the product attributes to the various states

SMF72S3.name: r723rwco
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for conversation state samples. Waiting for conversation may have been used in conjunction with the WLM service IWMMSWCH to identify where the recipient of the conversation is located. In this case, only the switched state will be recorded.

SMF72S3.name: r723rwds
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for distributed request state samples. Waiting for distributed request indicates a high level that some function or data must be routed prior to resumption of the work request. This is to be contrasted with waiting for conversation, which is a low level view of the precise resource that is needed. A distributed request could involve waiting on a conversation as part of its processing

SMF72S3.name: r723rwio
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for I/O state samples. Waiting for I/O indicates that the work manager is waiting for an activity related to an I/O request. This may be an actual I/O operation or some other function associated with the I/O request

SMF72S3.name: r723rwlo
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for lock state samples

SMF72S3.name: r723rwms
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for unidentified resource, possibly among another more specific category, but which may not be readily determined

SMF72S3.name: r723rwnl
SMF72S3.description: Total number of state samples reflecting waiting for new latch

SMF72S3.name: r723rwo
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for another product

SMF72S3.name: r723rwrt
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for regular thread samples

SMF72S3.name: r723rwsl
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for a session to be established locally, i.e. on the current MVS image

SMF72S3.name: r723rwsn
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for a session to be established somewhere in the network

SMF72S3.name: r723rwss
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for a session to be established somewhere in the sysplex

SMF72S3.name: r723rwst
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for SSL thread samples

SMF72S3.name: r723rwtm
SMF72S3.description: Waiting for a timer

SMF72S3.name: r723rwwr
SMF72S3.description: Total number of waiting for work table registration samples

SMF72S3.name: r723scscount
SMF72S3.description: Number of times an AS running with service class R723MCNM served service class R723SCSN

SMF72S3.name: r723scsn
SMF72S3.description: Name of service class being served

SMF72S3.name: r723spdp
SMF72S3.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised by z/OS Supervisor to a higher DP than the WLM assigned DP (in 1024 microsecond units)

SMF72S3.name: r723sucu
SMF72S3.description: zIIP on CP using samples. These are included in R723CCUS

SMF72S3.name: r723tpdp
SMF72S3.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority of work with low importance was temporarily raised to help blocked workloads (in 1024 microsecond units)

SMF72S3.name: r723tsucp
SMF72S3.description: Total service units consumed by transactions, executed on on general purpose processors.

SMF72S3.name: r723tsuocp
SMF72S3.description: Total service units consumed by transactions, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

SMF72S3.name: r723tsusp

SMF99S14.description: Date when the record was moved into the SMF buffer, in the form 0cyydddF.

SMF99S14.name: flg
SMF99S14.description: System indicator: Bit 0 reserved, Bit 1 subtypes utilized, Bit 2 reserved, Bits 3-6 version indicators, Bit 7 reserved

SMF99S14.name: hd_topochg_mpwq_hnode_length
SMF99S14.description: Length of MPWQ HNODE data section

SMF99S14.name: hd_topochg_mpwq_hnode_number
SMF99S14.description: Number of MPWQ HNODE data sections

SMF99S14.name: hd_topochg_mpwq_hnode_offset
SMF99S14.description: Offset to MPWQ HNODE data section

SMF99S14.name: len
SMF99S14.description: Record Length. This field and the next field (total of four bytes) form the RDW (record descriptor word).

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_affinity_node
SMF99S14.description: affinity node this CPU/Core belongs to

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_contcrossindex_nl1
SMF99S14.description: Container crossing index of nesting level 1

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_contcrossindex_nl2
SMF99S14.description: Container crossing index of nesting level 2

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_contcrossindex_nl3
SMF99S14.description: Container crossing index of nesting level 3

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_contcrossindex_nl4
SMF99S14.description: Container crossing index of nesting level 4

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_contcrossindex_nl5
SMF99S14.description: Container crossing index of nesting level 5

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_help_nodes
SMF99S14.description: Array of helper nodes of this aff.node. Only the first 44 helper nodes are supported.

SMF99S14.name: mpwq_highestcontcross
SMF99S14.description: The highest container crossing for Cores assigned to this node

SMF99S14.name: pof
SMF99S14.description: Offset to the product section from the beginning of the record (including RDW)

SMF99S14.name: reasm_indicator
SMF99S14.description: Only a subset of the available data is written to this record. The rest follows in subsequent records. This record contains a reassembly area.(V)

SMF99S14.name: record_incomplete
SMF99S14.description: Only a subset of the available data was written to avoid that this record gets larger than 32 kByte(V)

SMF99S14.name: slv
SMF99S14.description: System level from which record was cut (copied from CVTPRODN)

SMF99S14.name: snm
SMF99S14.description: System name from which record was cut (copied from CVTSNAME)

SMF99S14.name: tme
SMF99S14.description: Time since midnight, in hundreths of a second, that the record was moved into the SMF buffer

SMF99S14.name: vcm_an_bdycrossing
SMF99S14.description: CPs on this node are boundary crossing.(V)

SMF99S14.name: vcm_currtopo_tod
SMF99S14.description: Timestamp of the STSI returned SYSIB 15.1.x information which is currently used by HiperDispatch

SMF99S14.name: vcm_lparphysprocshr
SMF99S14.description: LPAR physical processor share for general CPUs/Cores scaled by 256

SMF99S14.name: vcm_maxaffinityindex
SMF99S14.description: Maximum affinity index the system supports for the life of the IPL

SMF99S14.name: vcm_maxcpuidforipl
SMF99S14.description: Maximum CPU ID/Core ID the system supports activating for the life of the IPL

SMF99S14.name: vcm_ptf_switched
SMF99S14.description: PTF was issued to initiate a switch opposite mode. However, the PTF return info tells us that we are already in the requested mode(V)

SMF99S14.name: vn2
SMF99S14.description: Record sub version. Used to identify changes to the record in the service stream

SMF113S1.name: cdof
SMF113S1.description: Offset to counter data section for this counter set, from the beginning of record. This can be to a SMF113_1_SCDS section or a SMF113_1_LCDS section, depending SMF113_1_CSUseLCDS

SMF113S1.name: coreid
SMF113S1.description: Core ID for which the hardware event counters are recorded. Note that zero is a valid core ID number.

SMF113S1.name: cpuid
SMF113S1.description: Processor ID for which the hardware event counters are recorded. Note that zero is a valid processor number.

SMF113S1.name: cpuprocclass
SMF113S1.description: The processor type for which the hardware event counters are recorded. Will be one of the following: 0 = Standard CP 2 = zCBP or zAAP see SMF113_1_zCBP 4 = zIIP

SMF113S1.name: cpuspeed
SMF113S1.description: Processor speed for which the event counters are recorded. Speed is in cycles/microsecond.

SMF113S1.name: csof
SMF113S1.description: Offset to counter set section from beginning of record

SMF113S1.name: cstype
SMF113S1.description: Counter set type for counters recorded: 1 = Basic, 2 = Problem state, 3 = Crypto-activity, 4 = Extended 5 = z/OS 6 = MT-diagnostic

SMF113S1.name: csuselcds
SMF113S1.description: When on the counter set's counter data section described by fields SMF113_1_CDOF, SMF113_1_CDLN, and SMF113_1_CDON is mapped by SMF113_1_LCDS, otherwise it is mapped by SMF113_1_SCDS.(V)

SMF113S1.name: ctm
SMF113S1.description: Time when this SMF record is written

SMF113S1.name: ctrversion0
SMF113S1.description: Zero counter version number. This number is incremented when there is a change to the meaning of a counter in the z/OS counter set

SMF113S1.name: ctrversion1
SMF113S1.description: First counter version number. This number is incremented when there is a change to the meaning of a counter or the number of installed counters in the Basic or Problem-state counter sets

SMF113S1.name: ctrversion2
SMF113S1.description: Second counter version number. This number is incremented when there is a change to the meaning of a counter or the number of installed counters in the Crypto-activity, Extended or MT-diagnostic counters

SMF113S1.name: cts
SMF113S1.description: Time when HIS Data collection started

SMF113S1.name: dof
SMF113S1.description: Offset of data section from beginning of record

SMF113S1.name: iof
SMF113S1.description: Offset of identification section from beginning of record

SMF113S1.name: lcr
SMF113S1.description: Event counter value delta. Contains the number of times a particular counter event has occurred since either the start of the HIS collection run, or the previous SMF 113 Type 1 record.

SMF113S1.name: lostctrdata
SMF113S1.description: When ON, the hardware indicated the hardware has lost counter data during the current interval(V)

SMF113S1.name: lostmtdata
SMF113S1.description: When ON, the hardware indicated the hardware has lost MT counter data during the current interval(V)

SMF113S1.name: scr
SMF113S1.description: Event counter value delta. Contains the number of times a particular counter event has occurred since either the start of the HIS collection run, or the previous SMF 113 Type 1 record.

SMF113S1.name: sof
SMF113S1.description: Offset to subsystem section from beginning of record

SMF113S1.name: ssf
SMF113S1.description: Bit 0 - Subsys ID after Sys ID(V)

SMF113S1.name: sty
SMF113S1.description: Record subtype: 1 = Delta event counters 2 = Hardware event counters

SMF113S1.name: zcbp
SMF113S1.description: When ON, a value of 2 for SMF113_1_CpuProcClass refers to a zCBP processor type, when off a zAAP processor type.(V)

SMF113S2.name: cdof
SMF113S2.description: Offset to counter data section from beginning of record

SMF113S2.name: cdon
SMF113S2.description: Number of counter data sections. This is the total number of SMF113_2_CDS sections for all the counter sets

SMF113S2.name: cff
SMF113S2.description: First SMF record for the instrumentation run. The counter values are the initial values.(V)

SMF113S2.name: cfl
SMF113S2.description: Final SMF record for the instrumentation run. The counter values are the values at the end of the run.(V)

SMF113S2.name: cfm
SMF113S2.description: Middle SMF record (activated by interval timers). The counter values are intermediate values. The number of intermediate records varies from 0 to many, depending on the duration of the instrumentation run. An intermediate recrod is produced periodically based on the SMFINTVAL parameter.(V)

SMF113S2.name: cfns
SMF113S2.description: 1=Internal flag indicating SMF record is created on non-standard instrumentation hardware(V)

SMF113S2.name: cpsp
SMF113S2.description: Processor speed for which the event counters are recorded. Speed is in cycles/microsecond.

SMF113S2.name: cpuid
SMF113S2.description: Processor ID for which the hardware event counters are recorded. Note that zero is a valid processor ID.

SMF113S2.name: cpuprocclass
SMF113S2.description: The processor type for which the event counters are recorded. Will be one of the following: 0 = Standard CP 2 = zCBP or zAAP see SMF113_2_zCBP 4 = zIIP

SMF113S2.name: cr
SMF113S2.description: Hardware event counter value. Contains the absolute number of times a particular hardware counter event has occurred.

SMF113S2.name: csof
SMF113S2.description: Offset to counter set section from beginning of record

SMF113S2.name: cst
SMF113S2.description: Counterset type for counters recorded in SMF113_2_CR: 1 = Basic, 2 = Problem state, 3 = Crypto-activity, 4 = Extended

SMF113S2.name: ctm
SMF113S2.description: Time when this SMF record is written

SMF113S2.name: ctrvn1
SMF113S2.description: First counter version number. This number is incremented when there is a change to the meaning of a counter or the number of installed counters in the Basic or Problem-state counter sets

SMF113S2.name: ctrvn2
SMF113S2.description: Second counter version number. This number is incremented when there is a change to the meaning of a counter or the number of installed counters in the Crypto-activity or Extended counter sets

SMF113S2.name: cts
SMF113S2.description: Time when HIS Data collection started

SMF113S2.name: dof
SMF113S2.description: Offset of data section from beginning of record

SMF113S2.name: iof
SMF113S2.description: Offset of identification section from beginning of record

SMF113S2.name: lostdata
SMF113S2.description: When ON, the hardware indicated the hardware has lost counter data on during the current interval(V)

SMF113S2.name: sof
SMF113S2.description: Offset to subsystem section from beginning of record

SMF113S2.name: ssf
SMF113S2.description: Bit 0 - Subsys ID after Sys ID(V)

SMF113S2.name: sty
SMF113S2.description: Record subtype: 1 = Delta event counters 2 = Hardware event counters

SMF113S2.name: zcbp
SMF113S2.description: When ON, a value of 2 for SMF113_2_CpuProcClass refers to a zCBP processor type, when off a zAAP processor type.(V)
